why: Universes at 0. A is the conjunction of sixteen theorems: the model forms (theorem_18_6_1_existence, _structurable, _in_particular, theorem_18_6_1, exists_push_of_model, all in a given covering model c), the model-free forms (theorem_18_6_1_modelFree, _in_particular_modelFree), the model-independence lemmas for (3), (4), and concrete witnesses on the reflection and half-space bundles. A → B: every existence form of A assumes two hypotheses B does not have: tame germ data hfT (IsScFredholmSectionFunctorTame f, not derivable in the project from sc-Fredholm plus S.IsTame) and the model form IsAuxNormFunctor N (Lemma 18.1.8's right side, with continuity of N on W_{0,1}), where B takes the printed Definition 18.1.7 (IsAuxNormBook), which the project shows is strictly weaker (IsAuxNormIn ⇒ IsAuxNormBook; the converse does not hold, lemma_18_1_8_book_without_continuity). Both extra hypotheses are satisfiable (the witnesses), so this is a difference of hypotheses, not of vacuity; with them added, main ⇒ B is proved (main_to_B_tame). B → A: B gives one Λ; A also asserts the 'in particular' for every Λ with N(Λ) ≤ 1, |dom-supp(Λ)| ⊆ U and (4), the model-c forms without HasStrongBundleUniformizers, a push-forward lemma and concrete witnesses, none of which follows from B. The conclusions otherwise agree: IsTameModel (A) and IsTameSubcategory (B) are equivalent under HasUniformizers (definition_17_5_4_three), which follows from F̄(α) ≠ ∅.
overlap: rt_overlap B_to_main: 2380 shared project theorems, essentially all reached through the vocabulary in the statements (IsStructurableFunctor, IsScPlusMultisectionFunctor, IsAuxNormFunctor, covering families, tame branched subgroupoids, orientation and model machinery), which the proofs of the banned theorems also mention. The only lemmas the proofs call are IsAuxNormIn.isAuxNormBook, refCoveringFamily, base_mem/refBundleUnif_mem, definition_17_5_4_three, isFunctorial_comp_sectionFunctor (the last also used by the item's proofs) and IsStructurableFunctor.isScPlusMultisectionFunctor.

main.note: B_to_main (passes #rt_check): apply B with IsAuxNormBook from the model norm of refCoveringFamily, and IsTameModel from IsTameSubcategory via definition_17_5_4_three. main ⇒ B is not available only because main assumes hfT (tame germ data) and IsAuxNormFunctor (continuous model norm) where B has neither; main_to_B_tame (passes #rt_check) proves B with exactly these two hypotheses added. So on the main claim the two statements differ only in these two hypotheses of the project's form.
